LandmarkDef.label: the Gaping Doom
LandmarkDef.description: The corpse of a sarlacc, its throat turned into a pit. The Junkers sell the right to dump into it, and everything the world wants gone goes down: chemical sludge, spent cores, worse. What has pooled at the bottom glows — a hard, wrong green that brightens toward the centre — and the air above it shimmers with heat that has no fire under it. Nothing that goes in comes back, and the ground around it is going quietly poisonous for a day's walk in every direction.
